description:
Goal: Eliminate repeated minimum selection in ProductMemo::mutate_product_wave while preserving exact semantics and deterministic observations.

Evidence: src/compiler2/pull.rs on baseline ad0ac47d3 (lines987 onward) and the uncommitted48 candidate uses pending.iter().enumerate().min_by(semantic_cmp plus mutation rank) on every pop, followed by swap_remove. N independent unique queued events with no added readers require N(N-1)/2 comparisons. Deduplication happens after selection. This is a verified preexisting algorithmic defect, not a runtime benchmark claim. Open-ticket search found no mutation-wave coverage; tfn32 concerns producer retries and kdt7 fact subscription replacement.

Strategy: TDD through the production mutation-wave path. Establish the ordering actually required for mixed mutation strengths and deterministic observations. Remove repeated minimum scanning with the simplest single worklist; prefer eliminating unnecessary ordering authority. No parallel scheduler, display-string authority or compatibility path.

Acceptance: Growing independent fan-outs and shared/duplicate reader paths prove subquadratic total work including insertion, selection and deduplication. Cover mixed Dirty/Invalidate/Refresh, cycles, pending/delivered rooted reads and external-state events under varied input order. Unchanged/unrelated requests do no new work; equal values preserve allocation/generation and do not evaluate downstream formulas. Preserve semantic answers, byte-identical artifacts and healthy producer/job counts, allowing only proven work reductions. Delete obsolete selection and temporary probes, update docs, run relevant full gates and fresh ticket-scoped cold review, one commit/close. Do not raise work budgets.

Placement: Required epic-tail work discovered during48 review; predates48 and does not block its correctness cutover. Blocks final tfn39 acceptance.48 must independently eliminate its newly introduced quadratic validation/maintenance.

## Read-only baseline research (2026-09-06)
Inspection of ad0ac47d3 confirms ordering cannot simply be discarded without proof. Dirty on a pending reader must escalate to Invalidate; Refresh reads current dependency/rooted dirtiness; Invalidate removes reverse subscriptions. Preserve distinct (mutation, product) pairs, not product-only dedup. Moving exact-pair dedup from pop to enqueue is a candidate simplification: duplicate pops currently perform no mutation. Pin effective mutation sequence and external state to establish equivalence.

Required concrete controls: (1) a batch's equal then changed inputs produce Refresh and Invalidate for one reader, with invalidation still winning as required; (2) Dirty reaches a pending reader through duplicate paths and still escalates, extending dirty_external_chain_retracts_a_pending_effect_group_snapshot; (3) a processed seed exposes a newly smaller semantic key, preserving dynamic-min behavior rather than merely sorting the initial seeds; (4) an ordinary refresh cannot clear another rooted member's pending work, including pending/delivered queries; (5) growing independent fan-outs, diamonds, repeated identical seeds and pending cycles count insertion, duplicate rejection, comparison, pop and edge work.

Reuse candidates, not a selected implementation: SharedOrder (src/compiler2/shared_order.rs insert/remove_first) supplies comparator-driven balanced ordering, but is a persistent path-copying tree. Root verified insert, balanced and remove_first clone keys/values and allocate replacement paths. Positioned ProductKey contains TransportPosition -> ExecutableSymbol -> ActivationSymbol.input: Box<[Ty]>, so direct tree reuse would also copy positioned input arrays along replacement paths. Do not call fewer comparisons a speedup while ignoring these costs. Compare its full work/allocation shape with the simplest transient ordered worklist that retains the same typed comparator; do not add a ranking/key cache or parallel scheduler. Agenda is FIFO and clears dedup on pop; OrderedSet removal is linear retain; scheduler take_next_fact_change is another minimum scan, so none is an improved drop-in.

Before ordered-key dedup, verify distinct product keys cannot compare equal (existing sort_product_keys invariant). Retain semantic_cmp plus mutation rank unless tests and actual consumer semantics prove a simpler order sound. Update the product/worklist section of .agent/docs/fact-engine.md when implementing. Research made no source/test/branch changes and is not RED/GREEN evidence or authority to relax any acceptance requirement.

## Current reuse and integration boundary
fz-tfn.48 is committed as e616d82d13cc4e916bfae8e5a48e5219ac680d8a and contains the accepted move-only comparator-driven OrderedWorklist min-heap in src/compiler2/ordered_worklist.rs. Reuse it; no second ordering algorithm is needed. from_sorted requires sorted input: admit arbitrary seeds into an initially empty heap or sort them once, never pass arbitrary seeds as sorted.

Use one transient wave-lifetime exact (mutation,key) admission authority; reject duplicates before heap insertion and preserve distinct strengths. Keep ProductKey.semantic_cmp followed by Invalidate < Dirty < Refresh unless a stronger semantic proof removes that order. Dynamic smaller discoveries compete immediately. Count insertion comparisons, admission attempts/rejections, pops, processed mutations and edges through the production wave, not just heap helper comparisons. Delete the old min_by/swap_remove selection and duplicate-pop handling. Retain all earlier semantic/allocation/artifact controls and unchanged healthy pins.

The unaccepted46 candidate is safely parked in immutable stash710cba048553f39fbfcb4eb49171b92cdb7809f7 pending source-ownership policy53. Independent50 is accepted and pushed as21af71f13ff6f9b254cfadcecf2f37285c0fc274; the source/index was clean at selection, so this ready ticket could proceed on that baseline without restoring46. Preserve50 borrowed pulls and shared diagnostic wait batches. Future46 restoration must reconcile both accepted cutovers, not resurrect parked adapters. Scheduler fact-wave scanning and equal-key newest-first chronology are separately tracked in fz-tfn.52; they are not silently added to49. The two paths share OrderedWorklist mechanics but have different admission semantics. No source/test/branch edits or RED/GREEN claim arose from this preparation.

## Active TDD evidence and selected work model
Root inspected the genuine pre-production RED in /tmp/fz-tfn49-selection-red.log: 32 unique produced/observed products with four repetitions perform 8128 comparisons against a bound of 896; exact withdrawals and unique mutation assertions passed before the work assertion. The dynamic-smaller-reader baseline control passed under both seed orders (/tmp/fz-tfn49-dynamic-order-baseline.log). No production change preceded this RED.

Selected model: reuse the existing owned seed Vec, reject exact-pair duplicates before selection, typed-sort unique seeds once, then use the accepted OrderedWorklist for dynamic minima. One transient wave-lifetime admission helper stores one key per product and independent admission bits for Invalidate, Dirty, and Refresh. Its exclusive Empty/One/Many representation keeps the first product inline and promotes by moving that same owned key into HashMap<ProductKey, mutation mask> only when a second distinct product appears. At most one representation is authoritative; no parallel inventory or retained cache. Single-product waves need no admission-map allocation or key hashing. Promotion, actual miss/insert hashes, key equality and key copies must all be included in cost proof; empty-map lookups may skip hashing, so measure the compiled operation rather than assuming an extra first hash. Borrowed lookup rejects an already-seen strength before any queue or admission-key clone; a new strength updates the existing mask without copying its key. Only the first admission of a product clones its map key; each newly admitted dynamic strength clones one heap key. Owned initial seeds move into the heap. This is a compact representation of exact-pair membership, not a second identity or retained store. Rejected borrowed positioned keys must not acquire new backing clones; the queue moves original keys. Extend existing ProductValidation only with irreducible causal counts and derive redundant totals. Final counters retain mutation_admissions, mutation_pops and mutation_edges; effective mutations equal unique popped pairs, and rejected attempts are admissions minus pops. The prototype mutation_visits field was removed rather than retained as a redundant counter or JSON alias. Record comparable old-path work before replacing selection: existing tuple statistics are consumed only by finish_validation, so old public ordering totals omit other callers and cannot alone establish whole-wave improvement. Count actual short-circuit dependency inspections without new scans or sorting. Remove obsolete partial accounting, old selection, and all temporary instrumentation after cutover. Replace the old finish_validation-only refresh_visits signal with complete mutation visits; do not leave an always-zero legacy field or JSON alias. Tests must cover all three independent strength bits, key ownership across strengths, rejection without backing copies, and final Dirty-to-already-seen-Invalidate attribution without a telemetry-only key clone.

Acceptance emphasis reaffirmed by user: simplification and reduced total compiler work are requirements. Fewer comparisons alone is insufficient if costs move into key copies, allocations, hashing, or additional edge visits. No second ordering algorithm, retained registry, compatibility path, or raised healthy budget. Exact preceding CI34028301967 is now SUCCESS for21af71f13ff6f9b254cfadcecf2f37285c0fc274, independently checked after test completion2026-09-06T11:08UTC. Its push gate is satisfied;49 still needs its own complete gates and cold acceptance.

## Cutover in progress
First actual heap prototype /tmp/fz-tfn49-wave-prototype.log,58089 terminal0: all three focused work/strength controls GREEN. Old min_by selection, post-pop duplicate handling and unused partial tuple return removed. This is not final acceptance: direct hash/clone/backing controls, complete semantic controls, documentation, full gates, independent candidate proof and final cold review remain.

Root review caught a positioned-key copy regression in the initial Dirty-on-pending implementation: borrowed escalation copied the key solely to retain final-report attribution. Implementation now moves an owned key into accepted Invalidate; a rejected owned admission returns its original key for attribution. Successful admission guarantees later queued work can supply the final report key. Direct backing tests must verify both branches.

Independent interim cold review confirms the admission model in principle and verifies old proof artifacts, but explicitly withholds final acceptance pending the frozen candidate. Accounting includes actual map promotion/rehashing/misses and copies. mutation_edges measures propagated-reader, rooted-notification and short-circuit readiness inspections, not unlink scans in remove_reader_dependencies. Unchanged effective mutation order and unchanged displacement/unlink code must establish the latter work; this metric alone is not exhaustive whole-wave work.
